title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to renew on a multi-year basis, as you indicated that only multi-year volume agreements change prices. Our planned volume is 20000 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months, as shown in the attached term sheets.

Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a change of 4.2% for this part, so the volume base is growing.

The cost movements you mentioned justify far less than the step up from our current price. The attached packages reflect that.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant or a stock-based delivery model would lower your cost?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Unfortunately, your target price is not feasible given the current cost environment, despite the projected volume. 

Thank you for your proposal. We can accommodate a 24-month contract term and have adjusted our price to €4.88 per unit for this package. Our main Angebot stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Regarding your questions on alternative variants and delivery models, our technical and logistics teams will provide an assessment shortly. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 6306-2Z C3, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for moving to a 24-month term. We can commit to 20000 pieces per year for 36 months, or alternatively 24 months, as shown in the attached term sheets.

Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 records 302 ppm, twice your standard commitment of 150 ppm.
The same scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of only 85.0%.

At that performance level, a price increase above our current price is hard for us to justify internally.

In June, your owner offered to walk us through your calculation of hourly rates and material. Could we arrange that, or an authorised pricing review, before you finalise?

Which of the attached packages could you make your primary offer?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 6306-2Z C3, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. 

Regarding your request for a pricing review, our current offer reflects our final calculation and we cannot provide a further breakdown of costs. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We have reviewed your scorecard data regarding quality and delivery; while we acknowledge the figures, they do not alter our pricing structure. As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, we can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract term, maintaining the payment terms at 60 days net, for a unit price of €4.91. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 7 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
